methods.name: Starlet · automatic regions
methods.note: Independent B3-starlet prototype with connected regions and covariance morphology. Not a DAWIS implementation. No manual region masks.

panels.name: Signed residual
panels.description: Zero = gray; positive = orange; negative = blue. Fixed range ±0.1 display luminance. 67614 preview pixels saturate; numerical residuals are retained.

panels.name: Reconstruction
panels.description: Sum of all components plus signed residual. Agreement checks bookkeeping, not whether the structure separation is correct.

panels.name: Detected structure outlines
panels.description: Automatically detected support boundaries. Colors indicate morphology, not verified stars or gas.

methods.name: getsf · official extraction
methods.note: The native 512×512 getsf run reached its 30-minute bound. Source-background separation converged in 19 iterations; filament separation did not finish. No partial component maps are presented.

metadata.crop: Native 512×512 pixels; original origin (2156, 956). No resampling.
limitations: All quantities use display sRGB, not calibrated photometry or measured gas density.
Compact/filament labels describe morphology; they do not distinguish foreground stars from intrinsic knots.
Residuals must remain accounted for. Exact reconstruction alone cannot validate a decomposition.
This experiment compares automatic 2D extraction. No new 3D depth model has been baked.
